We need to assess faithfulness etc. Check citations: plan lines claim ampicillin+gentamicin. Evidence S002 says recommendation for critical illness: ampicillin IM/IV plus gentamicin IM/IV for at least 10 days. So citation correct. Also S010 and S011 about staphylococcal sepsis but still ampicillin+gentamicin? S010 says IM/IV plus gentamicin (missing ampicillin?). Actually S010: "IM/IV plus gentamicin IM/IV for at least 10 days is recommended as first-choice antibiotic management." ambiguous drug. Might be cloxacillin? But plan cites ampicillin+gentamicin. S010 may not support ampicillin. S011 supports cloxacillin+gentamicin. So citation correctness partially off. Also S009 is background definitions, not recommendation. So lines L011-L019 rely on S002 primarily. Citation mapping unknown. So citation completeness: they cite multiple sources but some not needed. Might be okay.

Unsupported claims: risk analysis numbers (Score 14, 45 per 1000) not in evidence. No source. So L005, L008 have point breakdown not in evidence. Also severity classification CRITICAL risk (Score 14) not sourced. So list those.

Ungrounded dose: they mention dose not specified, but they state "Dose and frequency not specified in retrieved WHO guideline excerpts; consult local protocol". That's fine, not ungrounded. No numeric dose given. So ungrouned_dose false.
